note: Both sets share the same misread of the Living Room finished floor as 2' - 3 1/2" when the sheet reads 2' - 9 1/2". Set A otherwise binds values correctly (section scales for A1 and C1, room containment in each section, Mechanical Room within the Centre Module, West Module adjacent to Centre Module) with supporting quotes. Set B adds several vague or misbound claims — CENTRE MODULE 'location K' (a grid line), Mechanical Room 'location Building Section A302' (a sheet number, not a location), 'WEST MODULE location West' (tautological), and generic 'building section contains room' entries — plus more duplicate claims. Set A is therefore more faithful and less padded.
